name: shopee-lite
description: Microservices demo: NestJS + Kafka + API gateway + PostgreSQL

scripts.up:infra: docker compose up postgres kafka kafka-ui
scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f order-service inventory-service notification-service user-service
scripts.seed: docker compose exec inventory-service node dist/seed/seed.js
scripts.seed:reset: docker compose exec inventory-service node dist/seed/seed.js --reset-stock
